notices.html: Six Flags' reimagined Holiday in the Park opens to the public this Saturday, Nov 21 (passholder preview is Friday the 20th). Public dates run Nov 21 to Jan 3, 1pm to 8pm, included with park admission and with Silver, Gold and Prestige passes. Opening weekend, four new themed lands and a 65-foot tree, so expect a crowd.

Polar Express tickets, first dates are now next weekend: Nov 27 to 29 at both Whippany (Morristown & Erie) and Phillipsburg (Delaware River Railroad), then Dec 4 to 6, 11 to 13, and 18 to 20. These sell out, so if you want a date, book this week.

Three library programs this weekend open registration the day before, not now: Lawrence Storytime (Sat 11am) and Lawrence 3D Turkey Painting (Sat 2:30pm) both open Friday Nov 20; Lawrence Felted Acorn Garlands (Sun 2pm) opens Saturday Nov 21 at 2pm. Set a reminder, these fill the same day.

Already full for Saturday: two of the three South Brunswick planetarium sessions (3pm and 4:30pm, the 1:30pm still had seats), and at Princeton Public Library both Chemistry Saturdays sessions and the Zentangle workshop. Book the planetarium now if you want it.

Pick-your-own is finished for the season. Terhune's Winery Weekend Music Series still runs Saturdays and Sundays through November, noon to 5pm with live music 1 to 4pm, and the farm markets and bakeries are open daily for Thanksgiving pies and turkey orders. Call before driving to any farm expecting to pick something.

blurbs.terhune: This weekend: no picking, but the Winery Weekend Music Series runs Saturday and Sunday noon to 5pm with live music 1 to 4pm at the vineyard tasting room. Farm market and bakery open daily, and Thanksgiving is next week, so call 609-924-2310 now about pies and pre-orders rather than showing up Thanksgiving week.
blurbs.leeturkey: This weekend: Thanksgiving is Nov 26, and this is the farm's busiest stretch, they fill around 1,000 turkeys most years. Call 609-448-0629 before you drive over, both to order and to check what vegetables are still pickable.
blurbs.vonthun: This weekend: the Monmouth Junction fall festival and corn maze are over for the season, leaving the farm market. Call 732-329-8656 to confirm hours before you go.
blurbs.emerys: This weekend: corn maze and hayrides listed only through late October, so that part of the season is over, and berries are long done. Call the picking hotline at 609-758-8514 or check emerysfarm.com before you go.
blurbs.battleview: This weekend: still no apple picking after the spring freeze took the whole crop, the farm's first total loss in five generations. The year-round country store is open daily with its own apple cider donuts made from sourced apples. Call 732-462-0756 before you drive over.
blurbs.johnsons: This weekend: the weekend Harvest Festival with gem mining and the corn maze has typically run only through October, so expect just the farm store and bakery. Call 609-654-8643 to check, and ask about Thanksgiving pies while you have them on the phone.
blurbs.diggerland: This weekend: Diggerfest ended Nov 15 and the park is heading into its winter break. Check the park's own calendar before driving down, since off-season weekends are not all open.
blurbs.sixflags: This weekend is opening day for the reimagined Holiday in the Park, Saturday Nov 21, 1pm to 8pm, included with park admission and with Silver, Gold and Prestige passes. Four new themed lands, a 65-foot tree, nightly tree lighting, Santa photos and s'mores fire pits. Runs select dates through Jan 3. Check sixflags.com/greatadventure for the date calendar and tickets.

events.title: Family planetarium, inside an inflatable dome
events.desc: Step inside a portable planetarium and find the stars, constellations and planets you can actually look for that night. All ages, free, run by the library at the Community Center gym on New Road.
events.note: Only the 1:30 session had seats, 3pm and 4:30pm are full

events.title: Lenni-Lenape crafts and stories
events.desc: Native American Heritage Month, run with the West Windsor Historical Society: crafts and stories about the Lenni-Lenape who lived here. Free, 20 seats when checked.
events.note: Our own branch, five minutes away

events.title: Art for Families: Repeat It
events.desc: Drop-in family art making in the Creativity Labs, no registration and no admission charge. Open Studio follows 1 to 4:30pm if they want to keep going, and 12 to 4:30pm on Sunday.
events.note: Free, drop in any time in the window

events.title: Read to JoJo the therapy dog
events.desc: Fifteen-minute slots where a child reads out loud to a certified therapy dog. Ages 5 and up, free.
events.note: Arrive a few minutes early to pick your slot

events.title: Creative writing workshop, grades 5 and up
events.desc: City Kidz World Magazine runs a hands-on workshop turning a real memory into a written story. Free, registration required.
events.note: Two hours, good fit for the older one

events.title: Holiday in the Park opening day
events.desc: First public day of the rebuilt Holiday in the Park: four themed lands, a 65-foot tree, nightly tree lighting, Santa photos and s'mores fire pits. Included with park admission and with Silver, Gold and Prestige passes.

events.title: Turkey rock painting
events.desc: Paint a turkey onto a rock with acrylic markers, instruction provided. Ages 4 to 12, free, 8 seats when checked.
events.note: Half an hour, dress for mess

events.title: Public speaking for grades 5 to 8
events.desc: Speak Spark: games and activities that build up to real public speaking, leadership and collaboration. Free, registration required. A grades 2 to 4 session runs at 2pm.

events.title: Winter Chalet makers' market
events.desc: Four lit chalets on the plaza beside the library, plus about fifteen weekend booths that rotate every week, so it is a different market each time. Free to walk through, runs Thursday to Sunday until Dec 20.
events.note: Week two of five, vendors change weekly

events.title: Drop-in board games
events.desc: Turn up any time in the window and play, from the library's collection or bring your own. All ages, free, no registration at all.
events.note: No booking, five minutes away, good rainy-Sunday default

events.title: Python for beginners, session 3
events.desc: Hands-on beginner Python bootcamp for kids, guided practice and small projects. Free, 8 seats when checked. Bring your own laptop.
events.note: Saturday's session was cancelled, this one is running

events.title: Thanksgiving storytime and craft
events.desc: Thanksgiving stories with Ms. Teri followed by a themed craft. Ages 5 and under, free, registration required, 8 seats when checked. A Spanish Day of the Dead storytime follows at 3pm.

extraPlaces.name: Winter Chalet Market, Hinds Plaza
extraPlaces.blurb: Four lit wooden chalets on the plaza beside Princeton Public Library, plus around fifteen weekend booths selling jewellery, ceramics, candles, prints, woodwork and kids' clothes. The weekend vendors rotate every week, so it is worth more than one visit, and it is the easiest Christmas shopping within fifteen minutes. Free to walk through.
extraPlaces.meta: Hinds Plaza, 66 Witherspoon Street, Princeton. Thursday to Sunday noon to 6pm, Nov 12 through Dec 20. Walk to Nassau Street for dinner afterwards.
